explanation: L0/N1408+ is a layer-0 token-identity lookup, not a context detector: its strength at a position is a fixed property of the single tokenizer piece there (token identity explains 100% of its scan variance, integrated gradients put 100% of every peak on that piece, and the same piece gives the same value in every context and at every position), so predict ACTIVE iff some piece of the text is one of a fixed ~2,200-entry firing set (4.4% of the 50,277 vocabulary) and INACTIVE iff every piece is outside it. The set is a fixed list, not a meaning class: it holds ordinary words that fire ('According'/' According'/' according' 1.73/1.49/1.13, 'Despite'/' despite', 'Instead', 'history'/'History', 'politics', 'evidence', 'Democratic', 'Regardless', ' fossil', and the bare capitalised pieces 'Introduction', 'References', 'Category', 'Opposition', 'Bayesian', plus the piece 'prud' inside 'jurisprudence') next to a long tail of rare, technical, foreign and name pieces, it is exact about the piece ('Introduction' 1.17 fires but ' introduction' 0.00 does not; 'References' 1.02 fires but ' References' 0.05 does not; ' opposed' 1.28 fires but 'opposed' 0.22 does not), and equally formal words never fire in any capitalisation or spacing ('however', 'although', 'therefore', 'government', 'report', 'important', 'analysis', 'statement', 'court', 'policy', 'proposal', 'parliament', 'methodology', 'committee', 'construction', 'region').
